summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for an exciting 2026/27 season with just one week until kick-off, having added some fantastic new signings and a returning player to bolster the squad. The Ramblers are looking to push for promotion and have recently unveiled three brand new kits, with sponsorship opportunities still available for interested businesses. After a narrow defeat to St Helens in their latest friendly, where the opposition made the most of their chances, the team will be eager to hit the ground running when the campaign begins.
